findings.what_goes_wrong: Constructing an AsyncTestCase with its documented default method name crashes because the generator-check wrapper is applied to a nonexistent runTest method.
findings.trigger: Call AsyncTestCase() without explicitly supplying a test-method name; pytest does this while collecting the abstract test base classes.
findings.expected: Construction should succeed, leaving a nonexistent default method unwrapped; instead getattr(self, "runTest") raises AttributeError.

what_examined: I inspected the Tornado library modules and their tests, ran ruff as a non-authoritative lead, ran pytest collection and selected unittest modules, and verified the reported constructor failure with the standalone script above. The remaining test failures were Windows ProactorEventLoop incompatibilities explicitly documented in tornado/platform/asyncio.py, not independently established code defects.
